LanguageData.Gun_DPM_RWP.description: "DPM is a durable machine gun from the mid-20th century, known for its simple design and reliable performance in combat. It offers a high rate of fire and solid stopping power, ideal for suppressing enemies with continuous bursts of fire. Its weight and recoil make it less suited for quick maneuvers, but in a static defense role, it excels at laying down sustained firepower."
